svg.title: Blueprint sheet 19, the mill stream: let the money go round, and turn the town’s own wheels before it leaves (after Neil McInroy and community wealth building)

g.text: turn the town’s own wheels before it leaves
they spend every year, and stay put.
it leaves in the end, too.
the people who work it, or the town.
the old saying: the mill cannot
grind with the water that is past.
its big buyers spent, the part spent
after Neil McInroy, CLES; Democracy Collaborative
a living blueprint for a world
